description: Kipper sat in the wet turbine-base concrete. Paw prints set overnight.
Whirl over-mixed batch 14. It came out as soup.
Kipper sat in the wet concrete again. Same spot. Same paws.
Lanky lowered the turbine base mould two feet left of the pegs.
Sprout built the scarecrow a door. On the roof.
Sprout 'improved' the paint colour to turnip.
Rain washed out the barn footings.
Flatt rolled the half-pipe flat. It is now a quarter-pipe.
Cat flap fitted upside down. Kipper unimpressed.
Wind blew the shelter roof panels into the duck pond.
Tipper delivered the office carpet to the farm.
